WITH e AS (SELECT timestamptz '2026-09-07 02:03:36.815119+00' t),
att AS (SELECT DISTINCT market_ticker FROM live_orders, e WHERE strategy='Fmmsell10' AND action='buy' AND created_at>=e.t),
fl AS (SELECT DISTINCT f.market_ticker FROM fills f JOIN live_orders o ON o.kalshi_order_id=f.kalshi_order_id, e WHERE o.strategy='Fmmsell10' AND o.action='buy' AND o.created_at>=e.t),
snap AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (market_ticker) market_ticker, COALESCE(quantity_fp,quantity::numeric) qty, realized_pnl FROM positions WHERE market_ticker IN (SELECT market_ticker FROM att) ORDER BY market_ticker, captured_at DESC),
sim AS (SELECT market_ticker, pnl FROM paper_trades, e WHERE strategy='Fmmsell10' AND pnl IS NOT NULL AND closed_at>=e.t),
fam AS (SELECT DISTINCT split_part(market_ticker,'-',1) f FROM (SELECT market_ticker FROM att UNION SELECT market_ticker FROM sim) u)
SELECT rpad(fam.f,22)
    ||lpad((SELECT count(*) FROM att a WHERE split_part(a.market_ticker,'-',1)=fam.f)::text,5)
    ||lpad((SELECT count(*) FROM fl x WHERE split_part(x.market_ticker,'-',1)=fam.f)::text,6)
    ||lpad(to_char(COALESCE((SELECT sum(s.realized_pnl) FROM snap s WHERE split_part(s.market_ticker,'-',1)=fam.f AND s.qty=0 AND s.realized_pnl IS NOT NULL AND s.market_ticker IN (SELECT market_ticker FROM fl)),0),'FM990.00'),9)
    ||lpad((SELECT count(*) FROM snap s WHERE split_part(s.market_ticker,'-',1)=fam.f AND s.qty=0 AND s.realized_pnl IS NOT NULL AND s.market_ticker IN (SELECT market_ticker FROM fl))::text,5)
    ||lpad(to_char(COALESCE((SELECT sum(pnl) FROM sim WHERE split_part(sim.market_ticker,'-',1)=fam.f AND sim.market_ticker IN (SELECT market_ticker FROM fl)),0),'FM990.00'),9)
    ||lpad(to_char(COALESCE((SELECT sum(pnl) FROM sim WHERE split_part(sim.market_ticker,'-',1)=fam.f AND sim.market_ticker IN (SELECT market_ticker FROM att) AND sim.market_ticker NOT IN (SELECT market_ticker FROM fl)),0),'FM990.00'),9)
    ||lpad(to_char(COALESCE((SELECT sum(pnl) FROM sim WHERE split_part(sim.market_ticker,'-',1)=fam.f AND sim.market_ticker NOT IN (SELECT market_ticker FROM att)),0),'FM990.00'),9) AS "fam  att  fill  realPnL  set  simFill  simUnfil  simNever"
FROM fam
ORDER BY 1
